rationale: The schema change removes `Entity.name` (field 2) while preserving its reserved name and field number for future use. This aligns with the intended behavior: all v1 construction/read operations must omit the removed field, but legacy decoding of payloads containing field 2 should still decode it into a reserved slot. Generated bindings will be regenerated by buf generate to reflect this change.
assumptions: Generated bindings are regenerated via `buf generate` and do not need manual edits
All three runtimes (Python, TypeScript, C#) handle the removal consistently through their generated code
Reserved field numbers/strings prevent accidental re-use of removed fields in future versions
